godsverse: Who would have thought the apocalypse could be so much fun? Certainly not Katrina, she hates it. But her adventure through it is damned enjoyable.
How can a book be so violent and hilarious and brilliant at the same time?
The main character is a badass and I loved how she was so raw, yet realistically someone I would totally want in my corner.
I fricking loved it and wanted to savour every part of it.
obsidian-spindle: A dark, imaginative twist on fairy tales with real emotional stakes. Watching Rose fight for her life across the Dream Realm had me hooked from page one.
Great story! Really loved everything about it. Would definitely read more in the series!
It was interesting how this book drew on gods from around the world and various fairy tales.
dragon-strife: Gilda is so good-hearted. Even though she has been raised from birth to be sacrificed to a dragon, she still finds the ability to love and tries to see the good in people.
Mr. Nohelty has written a book with a large number of surprises in it. Ewig is a surprising dragon as you discover as you read the book.
An interesting concept underpins this - the grooming of someone as a sacrifice.
ichabod-jones: The artwork is superb and the storyline is creepy AF. This is definitely more Hannibal than Buffy.
This story keeps you glued to the pages afraid of what you'll find next and to afraid you'll miss it.
Fun exciting read. It’s a bit twisted, which is why it’s so interesting.
More I want more!! Need more!! Soo goooood.
cthulhu: A collection in which every single piece is up to snuff.
Lovecraft-inspired comic shorts that are funny, frightening and, in a few cases, shockingly poignant.
Some are sad, some are funny, some are downright frightening, but ALL of the stories included in this book are highly enjoyable!
wonderland: Dark, dirty, grimy. That's the Wonderland Nohelty shows.
Whether you love detective fiction with a bit of whimsy or just love the memory of Wonderland, this is the book for you.
And like Rabbit, one taste of the addictive elixir, all you want, all you need is more.
The writing convincingly builds the characters and atmosphere.
invasion: I loved this story. It provided EVERYTHING I look for in an SF story.
With plenty of moments that made me laugh and great characterization
The end of the world is a bad time to fall in love. That line says it all, doesn't it?
thevessel: Dystopian fiction is one of my favourite genres and this book is up there with some of the best I've read.
It had everything a great read should have.
I really enjoy Russell's writing, his character development, and his storylines.
mfdkh: I absolutely adore this book. The way it is written is so new and fresh.
Quite an interesting story that kept me guessing
sorryforexisting: I'd give it 10 stars out of 5 if I could.
Spaceship Broken (the original Sorry for Existing)
Angsty but thrilling I really enjoyed this book.

gumshoes: It was fantastic to read aloud.
It was fun and has many wrong turns.
worstthing: I LOVE this book! It has become a top 5 favorite of mine.
Very funny book that definitely makes you think.
tiafc: For being a shorter read it's surprising how quickly you get attached to the characters.
thevoid: I really thought that the characters were what pulls this together
